cells.gaps: No source found says any transfer goes without the authority's prior authorisation, or that the authority exists and has published a list, model terms or a general authorisation.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The 2024 law requires the authority's authorisation for every cross-border transfer [CMR-001][CMR-002], which answers question 1 yes and question 2 closed. The compliance period ended on 23 June 2026. The stage is 2.
